usage.callShape: GET https://stablefinance.dev/api/financials?ticker=AAPL&period=annual&limit=4 (x402, no body). NOTE: method is GET, not POST as the registry surface states — POST returns 405.
usage.outputShape: body.financials.income_statements[], body.financials.balance_sheets[], body.financials.cash_flow_statements[] (each array item has ticker, report_period, fiscal_period, period, currency, filing_url + the statement line items, e.g. revenue, net_income, earnings_per_share, total_assets, free_cash_flow)
quirks: Method is GET with query params, NOT POST. The registry/probe surface labels it POST, but POST /api/financials returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Only GET returns the x402 402 + 200 data.
Query param 'period' is REQUIRED (enum: annual | quarterly | ttm). Omitting it will fail validation.
Pass inputs as URL query params (ticker, period, limit, plus optional cik, report_period and report_period_gte/lte/gt/lt date filters in YYYY-MM-DD), not a JSON body.
'limit' is 1-50; the example used 4 to return the last 4 annual periods.
Result is nested under body.financials, with three parallel arrays (income_statements, balance_sheets, cash_flow_statements) — not a flat list.
x402 accepts Base USDC (eip155:8453) and Solana USDC; paid $0.02 flat on Base. confirmed=false at return time (settlement not yet on-chain-confirmed by qa-pay) but charge succeeded and data returned.

ENVIRONMENT-ONLY: the QA host's OS DNS could not resolve stablefinance.dev (public DNS resolves it fine to 216.150.16.193); qa-pay's fetch failed until dns.lookup was patched to that IP. This is a local resolver gap, not an endpoint problem — a normal agent on normal DNS is unaffected.
usage.guide: Call this as a GET (not POST) at https://stablefinance.dev/api/financials with query params — at minimum period (annual|quarterly|ttm) and a ticker, e.g. ?ticker=AAPL&period=annual&limit=4. It is an x402 endpoint at a flat $0.02/call on Base (USDC, no API key). The response is JSON; read the data from body.financials.income_statements, body.financials.balance_sheets, and body.financials.cash_flow_statements (each an array of period objects with line items like revenue, net_income, earnings_per_share, total_assets, free_cash_flow). Add report_period date filters (report_period_gte/lte, YYYY-MM-DD) to narrow the range. Do NOT POST — POST returns 405.
